title: File:Wood duck 2 R Koch (9606887167).jpg
art: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service Southeast Region
desc: Lake Woodruff National Wildlife Refuge, Feb. 3, 2012. This wood duck glides across the surface of the impoundment pond at the Refuge. Photo by:  Robin Koch, USFWS Volunteer. www.fws.gov/lakewoodruff/

title: File:Gulf Fritillary wings (9606643705).jpg
art: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service Southeast Region
desc: Lake Woodruff National Wildlife Refuge, Feb. 19, 2011. The brilliant orange color of the Gulf Fritillary makes them a colorful addition to any butterfly garden. Taken in the Visitor Center’s butterfly garden. Photo by:  Robin Koch, USFWS Volunteer. www.fws.gov/lakewoodruff/

title: File:Gulf Fritillary sipping nectar (9606645825).jpg
art: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service Southeast Region
desc: Lake Woodruff National Wildlife Refuge, Feb. 19, 2011. The iridescent underwings of the Gulf Fritillary can be clearly seen along with its striped body as it sits on a Garberia flower. Taken in the Visitor Center’s butterfly garden. Photo by:  Robin Koch, USFWS Volunteer. www.fws.gov/lakewoodruff/
